headline: US plans livestream of execution by firing squad
summary: US officials plan to livestream the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan. The former Army major was convicted of killing 13 people. This unprecedented move was revealed by anonymous Defense Department sources.

headline: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
summary: Anthropic introduced OSS Scanner, offering free AI security scans for open-source projects. This service uses powerful AI models to detect vulnerabilities. Projects get early alerts but share their code with Anthropic.

headline: SpaceX announces plan to become a ‘major mobile carrier’
summary: SpaceX acquired low-band spectrum licenses, aiming to become a major US mobile carrier. This move paves the way for its Starlink Mobile service. The FCC's approval will enable a new satellite-to-mobile architecture.

headline: AMD will bring FSR 4 to handhelds by the end of 2026
summary: AMD confirmed it will officially bring its FSR 4 framerate-enhancing technology to some handhelds. This reverses previous concerns about older device compatibility. AMD chip boss Jack Huynh promised support by late 2026.

headline: Princess Donut Blind Box Plushies Are Getting Shown Off at NYCC Alongside Dungeon Crawler Carl Action Figures
summary: Dungeon Crawler Carl merchandise is being showcased at NYCC. Princess Donut blind box plushies are featured alongside action figures. The LitRPG series has gained immense popularity this year.

headline: Street Fighter 6 Producer Reveals How He Helped Save Capcom’s Iconic Fighting Game Franchise From ‘Dying’
summary: Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto detailed the franchise's critical state during the Street Fighter V era. He and director Takayuki Nakayama worked to revive the series. Their efforts are credited with saving Capcom's flagship fighting game from dying.

headline: Ben Affleck Says He Gets Into Arguments With Kids in Fortnite, His New Movie Took Inspiration from Game's Skins
summary: Actor Ben Affleck revealed he plays shooters like Fortnite. He admits to engaging in arguments with kids via voice chat. Affleck's new movie also drew inspiration from game skins.

headline: Deadpool and She-Hulk Are Coming to X-Men '97 Season 3
summary: X-Men '97 Season 3 was confirmed at New York Comic Con 2026. A teaser revealed surprise appearances from Deadpool. She-Hulk is also set to join the upcoming season.

headline: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
summary: Search warrants used for Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were declared unlawful by a court. Police had seized material during their criminal investigation. The investigation into the former prince is ongoing despite the ruling.

headline: What does the ruling mean for the investigation into the former prince?
summary: The High Court ruled search warrants for Mr. Mountbatten-Windsor's home were unlawful. Special correspondent Lucy Manning explains the implications of this decision. The ruling's impact on the ongoing criminal investigation is discussed.

headline: Burnham calls on Polanski to reverse Green Party's Zionism motion
summary: The prime minister has intervened in a dispute within the Green Party. Burnham urged Polanski to reverse a controversial Zionism motion. The motion was passed by members at the Green Party conference.

headline: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
summary: Two Latvian men were apprehended for suspected trespass at an RAF base. Police arrested them around 02:00 BST inside the perimeter. The incident occurred at the Cambridgeshire military facility.
